seoTitle: Color Hue Quiz: Spot the Odd Swatch
metaDescription: A short game: find the swatch with a slightly different lightness. Differences shrink each round. Free, local.
intro: Shows nine swatches, one slightly different in lightness. Each correct pick makes the next difference smaller, up to 12 rounds.
why:
The quiz is built for fun and a rough feel for your colour vision on your own screen. Differences are measured in OKLab lightness, so steps are perceptually even. You get a score and the smallest difference you spotted.

It is not a medical test. Screen settings and room lighting change the result, and the game needs colour vision to play, so it has no non-visual mode.
howTo: Pick the swatch that looks different.
Read your score and smallest difference.

faq.q: Is this a colour blindness test?
faq.a: No. Use a clinical test for that. The Colour Blindness Simulator shows how others see colours.

faq.q: What do the difference numbers mean?
faq.a: OKLab lightness points on a 0 to 1 scale; lower means subtler.
Yes. Every swatch is a button with a name like Swatch 3 of 9.
To end the game quickly when the differences are below what you can see.
